title: Bicarbonate–chloride interaction adds a tiny, non-robust cross-cycle gain in handgrip prediction
abstract: Exploratory NHANES2011-12 to2013-14 adults40+ analysis: bicarbonate×chloride interaction reduces unweighted combined-grip MSE by 0.360034 kg² (400PSU-refit95% interval[0.027943,0.780069]);RMSE improves0.0158kg. Population-weighted and stronger sex/body-size-baseline intervals cross zero. No independent-system validation or clinical utility established.
